name: PATTERN_EXTRACTOR_TRADE_DEDUPE
comment: 9,241 scored rows for 118 closed trades (one row per recommendation per matching trade, and six
generations of trade_closed ids), so pattern_library reported '864 trades' built from duplicates and a
float_nano bucket that was entirely float_m = 0.0 missing data. The extractor collapses to one row per
trade before any bucketing, and a zero rvol/float is no longer a bucket. Listing it schedules nothing.
